title: Architecture Decision Records
summary: Writes clear ADRs and RFCs that capture the context, options, decision and consequences of significant technical choices.
changes: Renamed from architecture-decision-records to architecture-decisions and rewrote the description to start with "Use when"
Replaced the fixed docs/adr/ directory layout with neutral wording (record ADRs where the role's instructions say), keeping the numbering, index and superseding rules
Changed "Submit PR for review" to "Have it reviewed" in the index instructions
Removed the adr-tools automation section (brew install and CLI commands)

Trimmed team-process items from the review checklist (2 senior engineers, affected teams consulted, team notified, tickets created) to fit a solo founder: review by someone other than the author, implementation work identified
